en.t: There were nine people in the room altogether.

units.source_text: 片冈五右卫刚才去上厕所了。

en.t: Kataoka Goemon had just gone to the toilet.

units.source_text: 早水藤左卫门去到下房找人说话，迟迟未归。

en.t: Hayami Tozaemon had gone to the lower room to find someone to talk to and was slow to return.

units.source_text: 余下六人分别是吉田忠左卫门、原总右卫门、间濑久太夫、小野寺十内、堀部弥兵卫、间喜兵卫等。

en.t: The remaining six were Yoshida Chuzaemon, Hara Soemon, Mase Kyudayu, Onodera Junai, Horibe Yahei, Hazama Kihei, and the others.

units.source_text: 没人在意洒在拉窗的阳光，他们中有的埋头认真看书，有的在全心贯注的写信。

en.t: No one paid any attention to the sunlight falling on the sliding screens; some bent over their books and read intently, while others were wholly absorbed in writing letters.

units.source_text: 可能因为剩下的这六个人都是六七十岁的老人，乍暖还寒的房间里寂静无声。

en.t: Perhaps because the six who remained were all old men in their sixties or seventies, the room, warm yet still chilly, was utterly silent.

units.source_text: 就算不时有人咳嗽，但那声音也轻得无法震动飘荡在空中的墨香。

en.t: Even when someone coughed from time to time, the sound was so slight that it could not stir the scent of ink drifting in the air.
